# v0.1.28 preview

Owned artifact uploads now run when the workflow sets `retention-days` from
1 to 90. The worker validates the value and keeps artifacts with the local
run. For expressions, the upload step checks the resolved value before
recording files.

Submission errors identify the input field for unsupported keys and invalid
literal values. The capability version remains 12.

Workers now share package downloads across eligible jobs on the same host.
Each cache belongs to one repository and runner image. Default-branch pushes
use a separate cache from other branches and same-repository pull requests.
Fork pull requests receive no cache. Jobs can reuse Cargo, Python, JavaScript,
and Go package downloads, plus tools installed with `cargo install`, `pipx`,
and `uv tool`. Build outputs stay in the job workspace.

Caches count toward the worker's disk budget. The default size limit is
4 GiB and the default idle age limit is 14 days. Operators can adjust these
with `--package-cache-max-bytes` and `--package-cache-max-age-days`, or
disable caching with `worker --no-package-cache`.
